subject: Reassigning a seat after staff departure
body: Hi, one of our analysts left the company last week and I need to reassign her seat and report ownership to a colleague without losing the scheduled reports she'd built. I couldn't find a clean way to transfer ownership from the admin panel - it looks like I'd need to rebuild the schedules from scratch. Could you point me to the right process, or do it on your end? Not urgent, just want to get her account deactivated properly before month-end.

subject: Connector sync failing overnight - NetSuite source
body: Our NetSuite connector has failed its scheduled sync three nights running (24th, 25th, 26th Dec), throwing a generic 'source unreachable' error each time in the sync log. We've had to trigger manual syncs each morning to have current figures ready for the finance team. As part of next year's tooling review we've been asked to also look at Dashlume, but for now this is the platform we're on and would like it working reliably again. Could someone check what changed around the 24th?

subject: Dashboards showing stale figures again
body: Coming back to this - since the connector fix from December, the finance dashboards have started showing data that's a day or so out of date on some mornings, most recently the 25th and 27th of this month. It looks similar to the sync issue we reported before the patch. We've started refreshing manually before the 9am review, so there's no immediate urgency, but wanted it logged properly in case it points to something underneath the December fix that didn't fully take.

subject: New user invite not arriving — need to add analyst to account
body:
Hi,

I sent an invite to a new team member (anna.korhonen@[company].fi) earlier today and she has not received the email. Checked spam, nothing there. Can you resend or give me an alternative way to add her? We need her set up before end of week.

Thanks,
Mikael Hansen
Senior Analyst

subject: PDF export cutting off right side of wide tables
body:
Hello,

When exporting a report to PDF, any table wider than approximately 10 columns is being clipped on the right side. The data is there in the report view — it is only the PDF output that truncates it. We are sharing these exports externally so it is noticeable. Is there a page orientation or scaling setting we are missing, or is this a known rendering issue?

Mikael Hansen
Senior Analyst

subject: Provisioning new analyst seats - Enterprise plan
body: We're adding three new analysts to the finance reporting team starting next Monday and need seats provisioned under our Enterprise plan, ideally with the same dashboard and folder permissions as the rest of the team. Could you also confirm whether our current contract has spare seats available or whether we'll need to purchase additional ones? Happy to hop on a call if that's easier than email.

subject: Dashboard refresh delays during month-end close
body: For the second month-end running, our consolidated finance dashboard has taken 15-20 minutes to refresh, well past the couple of minutes we're used to, and twice this week it's timed out entirely before completing. This is landing right when the team needs the numbers most, which is not great timing. We're currently reviewing our BI tooling for next year, and Dashlume has come up partly because of stability concerns like this one. Could someone look into what's driving the slowdown?

subject: Seat count reconciliation ahead of renewal
body: Ahead of our autumn renewal we're reconciling licensed seats against actual usage and found four accounts still active for people who left the business in Q2. Could you deactivate the attached list and confirm the resulting seat count? We're also part-way through a proof-of-concept with Dashlume as part of the same renewal review, so getting our current numbers accurate matters more than usual this time round.

subject: Report builder templates failing to render - still
body: Coming back to the scheduling problem from April - the fix didn't fully hold. The leadership pack template still fails to render intermittently, most recently on the 15th and 18th, and we're back to spot-checking every scheduled send before it goes out to the board. We've built a manual verification step into our Monday routine so there's no crisis on our end, but wanted this documented properly given it's now come up twice. Our Dashlume evaluation is ongoing and this kind of thing is exactly what we're being asked to weigh up.

subject: Scheduled export time zone wrong
body: Our 6am scheduled export is arriving at what looks like 6am UTC rather than local time. Small thing but throws off our morning routine.

subject: API sandbox environment access
body: Requesting sandbox credentials to test an integration before we point it at production.

subject: Dashboard filter resets on refresh
body: A saved filter on our ops dashboard resets to default every time the page auto-refreshes. Have to reapply it manually each morning.

subject: API errors after year-end schema change
body: Since the new year fields were added, our API calls to the reports endpoint are throwing validation errors we haven't seen before.

subject: Export file corrupted on download
body: The last two exports we've downloaded open as corrupted files in Excel. Re-running the export doesn't help.

subject: Alert routing to wrong team
body: Separate from the export file issue we raised back in December, which we ended up working around ourselves, our stock alerts are now routing to the wrong distribution list after a recent reorg.

subject: Date filter defaulting to wrong range on report open
body:
Hi,

A report I built defaults to a 7-day range when opened, even though I saved it with a 30-day range selected. Every time someone opens it they have to manually reset the filter. Is there a way to lock the default, or is this a bug?

Erik Nieminen
VP Finance

subject: Alert email format — HTML rendering broken
body:
Hello,

Alert notification emails are arriving as plain text — the HTML template is not rendering. Tables and formatting are all showing as raw code. This started after your update on 26 November. Can you fix?

Erik Nieminen
VP Finance

subject: Report builder crashing on save with complex calculated fields
body:
Hello,

I am getting a consistent browser error when saving a report that contains more than four calculated fields with nested IF logic. The report saves partially — some fields are retained, others are lost — and I have to rebuild them each session. I have tried Chrome and Edge, same result. This has been happening for about two weeks and it is significantly slowing down our month-end prep.

This is the third separate issue I have raised in the past few months. I would appreciate a substantive update rather than a standard acknowledgement.

Erik Nieminen
VP Finance

subject: Sorting not applying correctly on grouped columns
body:
Report builder sorting is broken again. Setting sort order on a grouped column reverts when I add a second group. This is similar to an issue from a few months back. Please fix.

Erik Nieminen
VP Finance

subject: Report builder unusable for finance team — multiple active bugs
body:
Hello,

I need to escalate. The report builder is currently not fit for purpose for our finance team. We are dealing with: (1) the sorting issue from January which apparently was not fully fixed, (2) a new issue where adding a second data source to a report causes the first to drop, and (3) formula fields randomly losing their definitions overnight.

We have a board reporting deadline in 10 days and I cannot produce the outputs we need. I would like a call with someone technical this week, not a ticket that sits for six days.

Erik Nieminen
VP Finance

subject: Export to PDF blank — third time this week
body:
Export came out blank again. Third time this week. The report renders fine on screen. Please just fix it.

Erik Nieminen
VP Finance

subject: Export scheduler — confirm correct timezone handling
body:
Hi,

A quick question on the export scheduler. We are in EEST (UTC+3) but the scheduler appears to be running jobs in UTC. Can you confirm whether scheduled exports use the account timezone or UTC, and whether there is a setting to change this?

Erik Nieminen
VP Finance

subject: BigQuery connector — incremental sync not working
body:
Hello,

Our BigQuery connector is set to incremental sync but appears to be doing a full reload every time. This is causing sync times of over 40 minutes. We have a moderately large table (~80M rows) and a full reload every cycle is not viable. Please check the incremental sync configuration.

Erik Nieminen
VP Finance

subject: Dashboard shared link not loading for external users
body:
Hi,

We share dashboards externally via the public link feature. Since approximately 10 July, recipients are getting a loading spinner that never resolves. Internal users see the dashboard fine. Please investigate.

Erik Nieminen
VP Finance

subject: API key rotation broke our integration — no advance notice
body:
Hello,

Our API integration stopped working yesterday. After investigating we found that the API keys for our account were rotated. We received no advance notification of this. The integration is used for automated financial reporting and its failure caused missed outputs.

I would like to understand why keys were rotated without notice, what the standard policy is, and how we can prevent this happening again. I would also like a written response, not just a portal update.

Erik Nieminen
VP Finance

subject: Question on seat reallocation
body: We're restructuring a couple of teams - is there a way to reassign a seat's permission group without losing that user's saved reports?

subject: Report builder - nice addition, small bug
body: Really like the new drag-and-drop layout in report builder. Small bug though, resizing a chart element sometimes overlaps the table below it.

subject: Feature request: bulk role changes
body: Would be great to change permission groups for multiple users at once rather than one at a time - we do this a few times a year during reorgs.

subject: Feature request: conditional formatting rules
body: Any plans to support conditional formatting based on a second column's value in report builder? Currently only seems to support the same column.

subject: Dashboard drill-down not working as expected
body: Clicking through a chart to drill into the underlying data takes you to the wrong date range. Minor, but noticed it a couple of times now.

subject: Alert digest formatting suggestion
body: The daily alert digest email is great - would be even better with the metric name in the subject line rather than just 'Alert Summary'.

subject: Export file encoding issue — special characters corrupted
body:
Hi,

Exports to CSV are producing garbled output for Finnish and Swedish characters (ä, ö, å). The encoding appears to be wrong — looks like Latin-1 rather than UTF-8. We import these files into another system and the corruption causes failures downstream. Can you confirm the export encoding and whether it can be changed?

Juha Bergström
Senior Analyst

subject: Alert not firing on schedule — daily digest missing
body:
Hello,

Our daily digest alert (configured for 08:00 Monday-Friday) has not sent for three days. The alert shows as active and the underlying data is refreshing correctly. Could you check whether there is a delivery issue on the notification side?

Juha Bergström
Senior Analyst

subject: Grouping by week giving unexpected week boundaries
body:
Hi,

When I group a date field by week in the report builder, the weeks seem to start on Sunday rather than Monday. We follow ISO week numbering (Monday start). Is there a setting to change this?

Juha Bergström
Senior Analyst

subject: Report refresh not picking up new data source columns
body:
Hello,

We added new columns to the underlying data source and refreshed the schema in Kataja, but the report builder is not showing the new columns as available to add. Old columns are fine. Do we need to do something additional to make new columns available?

Juha Bergström
Senior Analyst

subject: API returning 500 on /reports/run — no useful error message
body:
Hi,

The /reports/run API endpoint is returning a 500 error for one of our report IDs. The error body just says "internal error" with no further detail. The report runs fine through the UI. We use this endpoint in an automated pipeline so the failure is blocking us. Can you check what is happening on the backend for report ID [REDACTED] and give us a more informative error or a fix?

This is now the fifth issue we have needed to raise in two months. The platform has been less stable than we expected.

Juha Bergström
Senior Analyst

subject: Conditional formatting not saving
body:
Conditional formatting rules are not persisting. I set them, save the report, and when I reopen them they are gone. Happened three times now. Please fix.

Juha Bergström
Senior Analyst

subject: User access audit log — where to find it
body:
Hi,

We need to produce an access audit log for a compliance review — specifically who has logged in and accessed which reports in the past 90 days. Is there an admin panel for this or do I need to request it from you?

Juha Bergström
Senior Analyst

subject: MySQL connector — sync failing with authentication error
body:
Hello,

Our MySQL connector has been failing to sync since yesterday with an authentication error. The credentials have not changed. We have had the encoding problem, the API 500, the alert issue, the conditional formatting bug — and now this. I am starting to keep a list. Can someone look at this as a priority?

Juha Bergström
Senior Analyst

subject: API rate limits dropped without notice — breaking production
body:
API rate limits appear to have been reduced. Our integration was working fine yesterday; today it is hitting limits in the first minute of operation. Nothing changed on our side. The MySQL connector issue from last week is still open. This is unacceptable.

Juha Bergström
Senior Analyst

subject: Report builder — data not matching source on specific date ranges
body:
Hello,

One of our key reports is showing figures that do not match the source data when filtered to certain date ranges (specifically anything crossing a month boundary). The discrepancy is consistent and reproducible. I have checked the data source directly and the source figures are correct. This is a data accuracy issue which is quite serious for us.

We have now had ten support tickets since June. I want to escalate the overall pattern, not just this individual issue. Can someone senior review our account?

Juha Bergström
Senior Analyst

subject: Bulk export job stuck in queue
body:
Bulk export job submitted yesterday morning is still showing as "queued." Other exports are completing. Is there a stuck job on the processing queue?

Juha Bergström
Senior Analyst

subject: Report builder — formula editor freezing on complex expressions
body:
The formula editor in the report builder freezes when I type expressions longer than about 200 characters. I have to save in pieces and refresh constantly. This has been the case since at least August. Is this going to be fixed?

Juha Bergström
Senior Analyst

subject: Dashboard widget arrangement resetting after publish
body:
Hello,

I am writing to report that dashboard widget arrangements are reverting to a previous layout after each publish action. Specifically, the process is: I arrange widgets, save the draft, publish — and the published version shows an older arrangement, not the current one. The draft view shows the correct layout.

I have reproduced this on three separate dashboards over the past week. My current workaround is to republish twice in succession, which sometimes — though not always — produces the correct result on the second attempt.

I recognise this follows a period of several open or recently closed tickets and I am recording the issue here for completeness. We will manage in the meantime.

Juha Bergström
Senior Analyst

subject: Confirm API versioning policy — v1 deprecation timeline
body:
Hello,

Can you confirm the deprecation timeline for API v1? We noticed a warning in the changelog about v1 being deprecated but could not find a specific date. We have integrations on v1 and need to plan the migration. Is there documentation on what has changed between v1 and v2?

Juha Bergström
Senior Analyst

subject: Connector permissions question
body: Setting up a new data connector for our subsidiary and unsure which scopes are needed for read-only reporting access. Guidance appreciated.

subject: API pagination behaving oddly
body: The reports list endpoint seems to skip a page of results intermittently when paginating quickly. Hard to reproduce consistently.

subject: Report builder template not appearing for new users
body: A shared report template isn't showing up in the library for two new starters, though it's visible for the rest of the team.

subject: Connector sync frequency question
body: Can we increase the sync frequency on the ERP connector from hourly to every 15 minutes, or is that plan-dependent?

subject: API response time slower than usual
body: Noticed API response times have roughly doubled over the past week for the dashboard data endpoint. Nothing changed on our integration.

subject: New subsidiary connector setup
body: Following up from earlier in the year, we're now ready to connect the second subsidiary's ERP instance. Same setup as before, just a new source system.

subject: API credentials not working after reset
body: Reset our API key yesterday and the new one is returning 401 errors on every call. Old key was revoked as expected though.

subject: Connector setup for expense system
body: Trying to connect our expense management tool and the connector list doesn't show it as an option, is this one we'd need custom setup for?

subject: Dashboard export button greyed out
body: The export-to-PDF button on our finance dashboard is greyed out for me but works for a colleague with the same role.

subject: Alert threshold seems to have reset
body: Our overspend alert threshold has gone back to a default value we didn't set. Not sure if this was a platform update or something on our side.

subject: API quick question on date format
body: What date format does the API expect for the from/to parameters on the reports endpoint? Getting inconsistent results.

subject: Connector for expense system now available?
body: Saw in the changelog that a new connector went live - is this the expense tool we asked about last year? Keen to set it up if so.

subject: API sync failing overnight
body: Overnight API sync to our reporting layer failed last night with no rows written. Team's already grumbling about just pulling the numbers into Excel manually if this keeps happening, would rather not go back to that.

subject: Export stuck in queue for over a week
body: Our scheduled export has been stuck in 'processing' for eight days now. A colleague who previously used Dashlume mentioned their export queue never had this problem, hoping this gets sorted quickly, this is dragging on.

subject: Connector auth expired without warning
body: The connector to our accounting system lost authentication with no notification email, so we only noticed when the numbers stopped updating. Would help to get an alert when this happens.

subject: Report builder chart type missing
body: Trying to build a stacked bar chart in report builder but only see the regular bar option. Is stacked available on our plan?

subject: Adding a new user
body: Please add one new user under our Standard plan seats, same access as our existing analyst.

subject: Dashboard looking great, small tweak needed
body: The new dashboard layout has gone down really well with the team. One tile is cut off on smaller screens though, could that be adjusted?

subject: API - question on batch endpoint
body: Is there a batch endpoint for pulling multiple reports in one call? Would simplify our nightly job nicely if so.

subject: Reorganising our team structure in admin
body: We're restructuring into three sub-teams and want to mirror that in admin groups. Happy to hop on a call if that's easier than back-and-forth tickets, no rush on our end.

subject: Feature request: connector health dashboard
body: Would love a single view showing sync status across all our connectors rather than checking each one individually. Not urgent, just came up in a team retro.

subject: Feature request: export directly to Google Sheets
body: A few of us still copy exports into Sheets by hand, a direct export destination would save real time. Throwing it out there.

subject: Following up on connector health idea
body: Saw the connector status indicators landed in the last release, nice, thank you. One more idea: could failures also show a suggested fix, not just a red dot?

subject: Export scheduling working well
body: Just a note that the export scheduler has been rock solid the last few months. Minor question, can the completion notification go to a shared inbox instead of just the creator?

subject: Alert rule cloning not copying all fields
body: Cloning an existing alert rule doesn't carry over the recipient list, have to re-add it each time. Small annoyance, team's still very happy overall.

subject: Year-end seat true-up
body: Ahead of renewal, could someone confirm our current seat count against what we're billed for? Just tidying up before year-end.

subject: API rate limit clarification for nightly batch job
body: We're building a nightly batch job that pulls report data via the API and want to confirm the rate limit for our Professional plan before we finalise the retry logic - the docs say 60 requests/minute but we're seeing 429s closer to 40. Could you confirm the actual limit and whether it's per API key or per account? Also happy to share our request pattern if that helps debug.

subject: API timeouts on /reports/export endpoint
body: We're seeing intermittent timeouts on the /reports/export endpoint since early February, roughly one in fifteen calls, logged at our end with request IDs (happy to send the full list). It's forcing us to build retry logic around a call that used to be reliable. We've started benchmarking Storsund BI's API as part of a general vendor comparison this quarter, and consistency under load is one of the things we're testing for, so it'd help to understand what changed here.

subject: Export endpoint timeouts - back again
body: Following up on the timeout issue from February - the rate limit increase you applied helped for a couple of weeks but we're back to seeing the same 429s and occasional 504s on /reports/export, about one in twelve calls this time. We've added exponential backoff and a local cache on our side so the pipeline keeps running, so this isn't blocking us day to day. Logging it again mainly so it's on record - we're still mid-way through the Storsund BI benchmarking and this is one of the data points we're tracking.

subject: Cloning a report template across folders
body: Is there a way to clone an existing report template into a different folder while keeping its filters and layout intact? I tried duplicating from the report list but it lost the saved filter set. Would be useful for setting up next quarter's regional variants without rebuilding each one from scratch. Let me know if I'm missing an option in the UI.

subject: API pagination returning duplicate rows
body: We've noticed the /data/query endpoint occasionally returns the same row twice across paginated calls when a report is large, which is throwing off our downstream row counts. It's happened three times this month that we've caught, all on the weekly sales report. We're de-duplicating on our side for now as a stopgap, but it'd be good to understand whether this is a known pagination edge case or something specific to our setup.

subject: Scheduled export file naming inconsistent
body: Our scheduled exports have started producing files with inconsistent naming - some carry the report date, others just a timestamp, from the same schedule. It's a minor thing but it breaks the folder sorting our finance team relies on downstream. Half the team has drifted back to Excel for the affected reports in the meantime since it's easier to just rename things manually there. Would be good to get the naming convention consistent again when you have a moment.

subject: Pagination duplicates - still happening
body: Coming back to the duplicate row issue from April - our de-duplication step is still catching roughly the same number of repeats each week, so whatever's underneath wasn't fixed, just worked around on our end. It's not causing us problems day to day since the stopgap holds, so no need to prioritise this urgently. More of the team has moved reporting into Excel since spring, partly for reasons like this, so the API traffic on our side has dropped anyway.

subject: Report builder learning curve - some pointers?
body: Team's still getting used to report builder. Ran into an issue where a formatted number field turns to plain text on export, took a while to nail down but appreciate the patience working through it with us.

subject: Export template question
body: Is there a way to save a custom export template so we don't reconfigure the layout every month?

subject: Question on plan seat limits
body: Trying to understand how many seats come with our Standard plan versus how many we're currently using, the numbers in admin don't quite match what we remember signing up for.

subject: Feature request: scheduled export templates
body: Following on from the export template question, would be great if a saved template could also be attached to a schedule directly.

subject: Feature request: simple API for non-developers
body: We're a small team without a developer, any chance of a simplified API mode or Zapier-style connector for basic data pulls?

subject: Report builder - template library suggestion
body: Would be useful to browse a library of pre-built report templates by industry, given we don't have much in-house reporting expertise.

subject: Report builder - thank you for the templates
body: The new template library has honestly transformed how quickly we build reports now. One small thing, the 'Operations' category template has a broken date filter, otherwise excellent.

subject: Connector question ahead of renewal
body: Looking at adding a second data source connector before renewal, can you confirm which connectors are included at Standard versus needing an upgrade?

subject: Dashboard drill-through request
body: Would it be possible to add drill-through from the executive summary dashboard straight into the underlying report? Board found the current two-step process a bit clunky.

subject: Complex alert logic - multi-condition rules
body: We'd like an alert that triggers only when two metrics cross their thresholds together, not either alone. Understand this took longer to scope given how specific it is, but really pleased with how it turned out.

subject: Feature request: API support for the new multi-condition alerts
body: Now that we have the combined alert rules working in the UI, could these also be configurable via the API? We manage most of our configuration as code.

subject: Feature request: alert snooze option
body: Would be handy to snooze an alert for a set period during planned maintenance windows rather than disabling it entirely.

subject: API - quick clarification on rate limits
body: Just confirming our Enterprise rate limit before we scale up a new integration next quarter. Support's been excellent all year, wanted to say so.

subject: Connector missing recent data
body: Our CRM connector hasn't pulled anything new since last week's sync, though the connection shows as active.

subject: Alert not sending to new recipient
body: Added a colleague to an alert list last week and they still haven't received any notifications, even though a threshold was clearly crossed.

subject: Connector re-authentication needed monthly
body: Our CRM connector seems to need re-authenticating every few weeks, is that expected or is there a way to make the connection more persistent?

subject: Currency formatting in report builder
body: We're building a multi-currency expense report and can't find a way to set a different currency symbol per column - it's applying the account default (EUR) throughout even where the underlying figures are in SEK or NOK. Is there a per-column override, or do we need to format this manually after export? Would appreciate a pointer if there's a setting we've missed.

subject: Report builder crashing on large templates
body: The quarterly board report template (around 40 tables) has crashed the report builder twice this week when saving, with no error message, just a blank screen and a lost session. We've started saving more frequently and keeping a local backup of the layout as a precaution. As part of our January tooling review we looked briefly at Storsund BI, though nothing's decided - would help to understand what's causing the crash regardless.

subject: Alert thresholds not triggering reliably
body: We've had at least two instances this month where a budget-variance alert should have fired (threshold crossed on the 3rd and again on the 9th) but no notification arrived, and we only caught it because someone happened to check the dashboard. We've since added a manual weekly check as a backstop, so it's not urgent from our side, but given the pattern we'd like to understand what's causing alerts to go quiet rather than just re-confirming the same settings again.

subject: Report builder formula error
body: A SUMIF-style formula in one of our reports is returning an error on some rows but not others, with no obvious pattern in the data.

subject: Transferring ownership of shared reports
body: A team member who owns several shared reports is leaving, how do we transfer ownership before deactivating their account?

subject: API timeout on large report pull
body: Pulling a report with a full year of data via the API times out after about 30 seconds. Smaller date ranges work fine.

subject: Dashboard tile broken after update
body: A revenue tile on our main dashboard has shown a blank chart since the last platform update. Someone on the team mentioned Storsund BI as an alternative during a demo we sat in on last month, so it would be good to get this looking solid again.

subject: Report builder - can't delete an old draft
body: There's a draft report we no longer need that won't delete, get a generic error every time.

subject: Alert delay of several hours
body: Our stock-out alert fired about six hours after the threshold was actually crossed. Someone mentioned Dashlume claims near-real-time alerting, so curious what the expected delay is meant to be here.

subject: API - field missing from response
body: The 'region' field that used to appear in the report metadata response seems to have disappeared as of this week.

subject: Alert list not respecting time zone
body: Alerts configured for 9am local are arriving at what looks like 9am UTC for a couple of recipients in our team.

subject: Connector year-end date range
body: Want to confirm the accounting connector will correctly split transactions across the fiscal year boundary before we run our year-end reports.
